fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.help: The bold first line at the top of every page, e.g. "Boil water notice in effect". Only the newest status is shown.

fields.name: detail
fields.label: Detail
fields.default: Water is safe to drink, no advisories in effect
fields.help: Optional. The line after the headline, e.g. "Bring water to a rolling boil for two minutes before drinking or cooking".

fields.name: color
fields.label: Colour

options.label: Red: boil water notice or outage (big red band)

fields.help: Green, amber and blue show as a slim strip under the menu, with a dot in that colour. Red shows as a large dark red band above the menu that stays on screen; use it only for boil water notices and outages.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date and time
fields.help: Shown as "Updated …". Bowie time. The newest date is the one the site shows, so to post a new status, use the current date and time.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date
fields.help: The newest three notices are shown on the home page.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Type
fields.help: The small label above the title.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.help: One or two sentences. The home page shows this instead of the full text.

fields.name: linkUrl
fields.label: Button link
fields.help: Optional. Adds a button under the notice, e.g. /reports/ccr-2025.pdf or a full https:// address. PDFs and other websites open in a new tab.

fields.name: linkLabel
fields.label: Button text
fields.help: The words on the button, e.g. "Read the 2025 report (PDF)". Leave blank for "Read more".
